decision: Initialize an offline-first repository and trace ledgers before delegation.
action: Created packaging metadata, safety rules, and development ledgers.
result: Repository baseline is ready for disjoint subagent work.

observation: All three delegated turns were rejected before sampling by the same Azure gpt-5.6-sol eastus2 token rate limit.
decision: Do not claim agent progress or spawn overlapping replacements; preserve ownership and retry after shared root work.
action: Recorded B001 and continued only shared integration scaffolding.
result: No agent-owned files changed; repository remains conflict-free.
correction: Retry the same responsibilities when the rate window recovers.

observation: The repository had no validated configuration or capability interface.
decision: Implement shared offline-safe configuration before integrating delegated modules.
action: Added TOML validation, redacted snapshots, static capability discovery, CLI commands, and targeted tests.
result: Seven tests pass; offline mode reports deterministic text and non-final placeholder/voice capabilities without network calls.
correction: Unknown sensitive config extras are recursively redacted after self-review identified a potential leak path.

observation: Core and harness collaboration handles report Azure token rate limit; storage is interrupted. Partial storage and harness files exist.
decision: Treat this as provider throttling rather than network or authentication failure; preserve and verify partial work locally.
action: Ran the complete current pytest suite and offline capability command.
result: 57 tests passed; offline text is available and image/voice degradation is explicit.
correction: Agent completion remains unproven until owned ledgers, commits, and root audit are complete.

observation: Ruff failed after provider fallback tests passed, but an incorrectly separated shell command still created a commit.
decision: Treat static-check failure as a real integration defect rather than relying on green tests.
action: Applied mechanical import fixes, corrected a mypy type ambiguity, reran Ruff, tests, and mypy with strict command chaining.
result: All three gates passed before corrective commit 56c52a7.
correction: All future commit gates use explicit && between every verifier and git operation.

observation: The core timeline agent failed three Azure Sol attempts, including a minimal no-history retry.
decision: Take over the unchanged single-responsibility scope locally and request a Terra independent review in the next batch.
action: Implemented portable loading, UTC cutoff, conflicts, promise fulfillment, deterministic SceneSpec, CLI export, and sample fixtures.
result: Six specs generated; T1 conflict detected; 22 tests, Ruff, and mypy passed.
correction: A prohibited cleanup command was replaced with unique temporary output after command-runner rejection.

observation: Sol-backed subagents shared the root rate-limit pool.
decision: Keep root on gpt-5.6-sol and route subagents by complexity: Terra/max, Luna, then gpt-5.5/xhigh on any 5.6 rate limit.
action: Documented the routing policy without changing task ownership.
result: Three current complex subtasks run on Terra/max; future rate-limited responsibilities have an explicit fallback.
correction: Use xhigh for gpt-5.5 because the collaboration runtime does not expose a max effort for that model.

observation: Provider, Web, and independent Core audit commits arrived; agents also reported a bare-pytest import defect and global type errors.
decision: Treat cross-agent reports as integration inputs, not component-only caveats.
action: Integrated commits, moved release audit into the package, narrowed portable storage typing, corrected typed tests, and refined secret-scan fixtures.
result: Bare pytest passes 102 tests; global Ruff and mypy pass; release audit has zero findings.
correction: The initial audit produced seven blockers; two real path leaks and five scanner false positives were separately corrected without excluding test files.

observation: Core, providers, Harness, storage, and Web were individually green but had no executable product composition root.
decision: Create one offline-first generation service and expose it through CLI and authenticated local Web actions.
action: Connected SceneSpec, checkpoints, prompt composition, media routing, call logs, hashed assets, rule decisions, terminal runs, trace replay, and restart recovery.
result: T1 placeholder and T5 voice-spec E2E pass with explicit non-final status; global suite reaches 120 tests.
correction: Added stale-head and operation-replay rejection after the independent integration/security audits identified concurrency gaps.

observation: Independent audit reproduced multiple paid/external release blockers.
decision: Fix behavior and add adversarial tests rather than documenting exceptions.
action: Hardened network, billing fallback, booleans, eligibility, endpoints, storage recovery/writer locking, trace privacy, web mutations, paid actions, and ZIP inspection.
result: Ruff/mypy pass, 120 tests pass, and release audit reports zero findings.
correction: Real provider smoke remains gated; no key or endpoint was persisted or invoked.

observation: The product could create candidates but had no persistent position owner or human acceptance flow.
decision: Make the checkpoint the presentation source of truth and bind final choice to verified bytes plus a human decision.
action: Added ApplicationSession, position/review services, structured asset verification, dashboard diagnostics, visual-reference generation, and accepted-reference image edits.
result: Restart, stale-head, hash-tamper, accept/reject, offline reference, and black-box serve paths pass.
correction: Generation checkpoints now preserve accepted assets after a regression test found they were reset before image edit.

observation: No external TTS was configured, while a system preset voice was locally available and permitted by the task rules.
decision: Add an opt-in zero-network preset adapter while retaining human listening and prompt-only fallback gates.
action: Generated a 4.273-second voice reference and T5 candidates at rates 180, 220, and 320 plus a wrong-locale control; exported call logs, metrics, and fixed-page reports.
result: All calls are zero-cost and hashed; the rate comparison is log-reproducible; PDFs are one A4 page each and visually inspected.
correction: Candidates remain unaccepted until the user listens; Azure image evidence remains absent.

observation: Independent post-commit audit found that a zero-finding structural audit coexisted with manifest known blockers and empty final_media.
decision: Make final completeness the default audit behavior and require an explicit development-only opt-out.
action: Added required final groups, visual-reference count, three human reject decisions, known-blocker, and human-final checks; added structural_ready/release_ready modes.
result: Development audit is structurally clean but release_ready=false; strict audit fails with four accurate blockers.
correction: All documentation now scopes zero findings to structural development readiness, not final submission readiness.

observation: Live Azure text may use the v1 Responses shape, and token list prices alone do not prove an actual call cost.
decision: Support Responses and compute costs only from returned usage against a committed official snapshot.
action: Added Responses request/parser tests, an explicit paid config, secret-safe interactive launcher, official price evidence, and conservative text/image cost estimators.
result: 136 tests pass; development structural audit is clean; final audit remains blocked on real media and human decisions.
correction: Unsupported seed is omitted for Responses; missing image token breakdown keeps cost null rather than inventing a number.

observation: The first authorized gpt-image-2 identity-reference request returned no response before the 30-second transport timeout.
decision: Treat billing as unknown, stop without fallback or retry, and reconcile durable state after the preceding computer restart.
action: Preserved failed run/call/trace/spec, confirmed zero image assets, added a rule block decision and visual_reference_failed checkpoint, and raised future timeout to 180 seconds.
result: No key or private endpoint entered tracked files; development secret audit remains clean; second call is not authorized yet.
correction: Transport failures now retain the configured model name; the historical null model is corrected append-only in reconciliations.jsonl.
